acquisition method: All samples were analysed in data-dependent acquisition on a setup consisting of an Ultimate 3000 RS nano ultra-performance liquid chromatography system
alkylation reagent: alkylated with 10 mM iodacetamid (IAA; Merck, Germany) for 30 min before urea concentration was diluted to <2 M with 20 mM HEPES pH 8.0
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 10 mM iodacetamid (IAA; Merck, Germany) for 30 min before urea concentration was diluted to <2 M with 20 mM HEPES pH 8.0; alkylated with 100 mM IAA for 30 min at room temperature (RT) in the dark
cleavage agent: For tryptic digestion, trypsin (Promega, USA) was added in a 1:50 (enzyme:protein) ratio and incubated at 37°C overnight
collision energy: fragmentation via collision-induced dissociation (CID) at a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 28; an NCE of 34 for CID fragmentation
enrichment method: immunoaffinity purification; High-Select™ TiO2 Phosphopeptide Enrichment Kit; High-Select™ Fe-NTA Phosphopeptide Enrichment Kit

used immunoaffinity purification to enrich acetylated label-free peptides; First, phosphopeptide enrichment was performed using the High-Select™ TiO2 Phosphopeptide Enrichment Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA); For the second enrichment step, the High-Select™ Fe-NTA Phosphopeptide Enrichment Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA) was applied
fragmentation method: fragmentation via collision-induced dissociation (CID) at a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 28
instrument: Q Exactive HF Hybrid Quadrupole Orbitrap mass spectrometer
coupled to a Q Exactive HF Hybrid Quadrupole Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA) equipped with a TriVersa NanoMate system (Advion, USA)
labeling: measured as described above for label-free quantification (LFQ) sample analysis; with additional tandem mass tag (TMT) labelling (TMT10-plexTM, Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA)
ptm: Carbamidomethylation of cysteines (C) fixed; oxidation of methionine (M) variable; N-terminal acetylation variable; acetylation of lysine (K) variable; phosphorylation of serine (S) variable; phosphorylation of threonine (T) variable; phosphorylation of tyrosine (Y) variable

Carbamidomethylation of cysteines (C) was set as a fixed modification, while oxidation of methionine (M) and N-terminal acetylation were set as variable modifications; For the analysis of samples enriched for acetylated or phosphorylated peptides, acetylation of lysine (K) and phosphorylation of serine (S), threonine (T) and tyrosine (Y) were added as variable modifications, respectively
reduction reagent: reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (DTT; GE Healthcare) for 1 h; reduced with 50 mM TCEP (Sigma-Aldrich, USA) for 1 h at 55°C
reduction concentration: reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (DTT; GE Healthcare) for 1 h; reduced with 50 mM TCEP (Sigma-Aldrich, USA) for 1 h at 55°C
